mapper.sql: id, user_id, systolic, diastolic, blood_sugar, heart_rate, weight, bmi, memo, recorded_at, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO health_record (user_id, systolic, diastolic, blood_sugar, heart_rate, weight, bmi, memo, recorded_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{systolic}, #{diastolic}, #{bloodSugar}, #{heartRate}, #{weight}, #{bmi}, #{memo}, #{recordedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM health_record WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM health_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY recorded_at DESC
SELECT FROM health_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND recorded_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) ORDER BY recorded_at ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS record_count, AVG(systolic) AS avg_systolic, AVG(diastolic) AS avg_diastolic, AVG(blood_sugar) AS avg_blood_sugar, AVG(heart_rate) AS avg_heart_rate FROM health_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND recorded_at >= #{start} AND recorded_at < #{end}
